utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can check the dues amount and let you know the payment options.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check and send you the amount and payment options shortly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about how the dues are being collected—can we confirm the amount and the deadline first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes—let’s confirm the exact amount and the deadline before anyone pays. Do you have the notice handy?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have it with me right now, but I can check and send you the amount and deadline as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the dues. I must’ve missed the update; how much are they now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, no worries — I think it’s still around twenty dollars, but let me double-check so I don’t give you the wrong number.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I appreciate it — I’m terrible at keeping track of these updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can bring it up at the club meeting and repeat the dues plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I appreciate you bringing it up at the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll bring up the dues plan at the meeting and make sure everyone hears it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a little late—what are the membership dues looking like this time?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — it’s still $20 for the month. If you want, I can spot you until payday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Appreciate it, Gus — I’ll take you up on that and square it when payday comes around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—can we confirm the dues amount and when it’s due? Then I’ll know exactly what to plan for.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the dues are $20, and they’re due by the end of the month. If that works, I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—thank you. Please send the details, and I’ll make sure it’s handled by month’s end.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, when are the club membership dues due?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: They’re due next Friday, Mina. If you want, I can help you remember the amount too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please—what’s the amount?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal — I can check on the club dues and make sure everyone’s on the same page. Want me to see what’s still owed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes please — could you check what’s still owed and let me know who needs to pay?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the dues and let you know who still needs to pay.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the club dues. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you send over the dues total and who’s already paid? I’ll keep the list updated from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’ll send you the dues total and a current list of who’s paid. Thanks for keeping the roster updated.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of the dues list, Bo—just let me know who’s paid and who still needs a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send you the names I know are paid and the ones still outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Bo—send them over when you can, and I’ll update the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the dues are due pretty soon — I can check the exact amount if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be helpful, thanks — I’d appreciate the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check the exact dues amount and let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the membership dues details before I say more—what amount and due date are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s $35, and it’s due by next Friday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that’s $35 due by next Friday, right? I’ll note that down before I respond.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh—right, the club dues. How much do I owe, and where should I send it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s $25 for the month, and you can drop it off with me or leave it in the club mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll drop off the $25 with you soon. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll check on the dues and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you checking. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep the others in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll check on the dues and circle back to you with what I find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the club dues. How much are they again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s thirty-five this month. I can get you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — thirty-five sounds right. Just send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the dues—did you want to go over what they cover?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can walk you through it. It usually covers the club space, shared supplies, and any little maintenance costs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot—thanks. Do we pay it monthly, or is it a one-time thing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, I’m happy to help with the membership dues. Do you want to go over the amount or the payment options?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s go over the amount first, please.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the membership dues are $25 per month. If you’d like, I can also break down what that covers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we know exactly when the dues are due and how much they are? I just want to make sure I’ve got the logistics right before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m not totally sure on the exact dates or amount yet, but I can find out right away and let you know. If you want, I can also invite you to the next club meetup so you can ask in person.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, thanks — please check the dues details and let me know. I’d also appreciate the meetup invite so I can ask in person.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the dues are really due this week, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s right — they’re due this week. If you want, I can help double-check the exact deadline.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the exact deadline for me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the dues—how much, when it’s due, and what it covers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, let’s keep it simple — we can set the dues amount, pick a due date, and write down exactly what it covers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s set the amount, choose a due date, and list the exact items it covers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits about the dues—what’s the final amount supposed to be?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got it listed as $25 for the year, unless they decide to adjust it at the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—$25 for the year sounds manageable. I’ll wait to hear if they change it at the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the dues. I’m sorry, Mara, I should’ve kept better track; how much do I owe?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — it’s $20 for the month. If it’s easier, you can bring it by later this week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I can bring the $20 by later this week.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take care of the club dues after I check the school schedule for this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—just let me know when you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve checked the school schedule, so I can handle the club dues now.
